positions.as_written: Measure the hyperextension in degrees on each side and record both figures.
Assess the other joints for hypermobility, since a generalised pattern changes the interpretation entirely.
Symmetrical hyperextension of a few degrees is normal and should be recorded as the patient's baseline rather than as a finding.
